title: Beginner
description: Understand and use very simple everyday expressions: introduce yourself, ask and answer personal questions, and handle simple exchanges when people speak slowly.

id.title: Pemula
id.description: Memahami dan memakai ungkapan sehari-hari yang sangat sederhana: memperkenalkan diri, bertanya dan menjawab hal pribadi, dan berinteraksi sederhana jika lawan bicara berbicara pelan.

nodes.title: The Verb “To Be”
nodes.summary: am / is / are in statements, negatives and questions.
nodes.canDo: Can say who people are and what they are like, using am, is and are in statements, negatives and yes/no questions.

objectives.text: Use am, is and are in affirmative sentences
Make negative sentences with am not, isn't and aren't
Ask and answer yes/no questions with to be

id.title: Kata Kerja “To Be”
id.summary: am / is / are dalam kalimat positif, negatif dan pertanyaan.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan siapa seseorang dan seperti apa dia, memakai am, is dan are dalam kalimat positif, negatif dan pertanyaan ya/tidak.

objectives.be-affirmative: Menggunakan am, is dan are dalam kalimat positif
objectives.be-negative: Membuat kalimat negatif dengan am not, isn't dan aren't
objectives.be-questions: Bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan ya/tidak dengan to be

nodes.title: a/an, the & this/that
nodes.summary: When to use a/an and the, and how to point at things with this, that, these and those.
nodes.canDo: Can use a/an, the and this/that/these/those correctly to talk about everyday things.

objectives.text: Use the for things already mentioned or unique (the sun, the door)
Use this, that, these and those for things near and far
Keep a/an before singular countable nouns (I have a car)

id.title: a/an, the & this/that
id.summary: Kapan memakai a/an dan the, serta cara menunjuk benda dengan this, that, these dan those.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai a/an, the dan this/that/these/those dengan benar untuk membicarakan benda sehari-hari.

objectives.use-the: Memakai the untuk hal yang sudah disebut atau yang hanya ada satu (the sun, the door)
objectives.demonstratives: Memakai this, that, these dan those untuk benda yang dekat dan jauh
objectives.no-missing-article: Tidak menghilangkan a/an sebelum kata benda tunggal yang bisa dihitung (I have a car)

nodes.title: Adjectives & Very
nodes.summary: Describe people and things with adjectives before nouns, after be, and with very or really.
nodes.canDo: Can describe people, places and things with simple adjectives.

objectives.text: Put adjectives before the noun (a red car)
Use be + adjective (She's tired)
Make adjectives stronger with very or really

id.title: Kata Sifat & Very
id.summary: Mendeskripsikan orang dan benda dengan kata sifat sebelum kata benda, setelah be, dan dengan very atau really.
id.canDo: Bisa mendeskripsikan orang, tempat dan benda dengan kata sifat sederhana.

objectives.adjective-before-noun: Menaruh kata sifat sebelum kata benda (a red car)
objectives.very-really: Menguatkan kata sifat dengan very atau really

nodes.title: Possessive 's & Object Pronouns
nodes.summary: Show who owns something with 's and whose, and use object pronouns like me, him and them.
nodes.canDo: Can say who things belong to and refer to people with object pronouns.

objectives.text: Use possessive 's (Rina's phone)
Use the object pronouns me, you, him, her, it, us and them
Ask and answer questions with Whose …?

id.title: Possessive 's & Object Pronoun
id.summary: Menunjukkan pemilik sesuatu dengan 's dan whose, serta memakai object pronoun seperti me, him dan them.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan milik siapa sebuah benda dan menyebut orang dengan object pronoun.

objectives.object-pronouns: Memakai object pronoun me, you, him, her, it, us dan them

nodes.title: There Is / There Are
nodes.summary: Describe places and what they contain.
nodes.canDo: Can describe a room or place and ask what is in it, using there is / there are.

objectives.text: Describe a room or place with there is / there are
Ask questions with is there / are there
Use some and any with there are

commonErrors.wrong: In my room have a bed.
commonErrors.right: There is a bed in my room.

commonErrors.wrong: Are there some shops near here?
commonErrors.right: Are there any shops near here?

id.title: There Is / There Are
id.summary: Mendeskripsikan tempat dan isinya.
id.canDo: Bisa mendeskripsikan ruangan atau tempat dan menanyakan isinya dengan there is / there are.

objectives.describe-a-room: Mendeskripsikan ruangan atau tempat dengan there is / there are
objectives.ask-questions-with: Bertanya dengan is there / are there
objectives.some-any: Memakai some dan any dengan there are

nodes.title: Simple Present Tense
nodes.summary: Talk about habits and facts in the simple present.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about habits, facts and things that are generally true, using the simple present in statements, negatives and questions.

objectives.text: Form basic affirmative sentences (including he/she/it + -s)
Form basic negative sentences with don't / doesn't
Ask and answer simple present questions with do / does

id.title: Simple Present Tense
id.summary: Membicarakan kebiasaan dan fakta dengan simple present.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan kebiasaan, fakta dan hal yang umumnya benar dengan simple present dalam kalimat positif, negatif dan pertanyaan.

objectives.negative: Membentuk kalimat negatif dasar dengan don't / doesn't
objectives.questions: Bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan simple present dengan do / does

nodes.title: Have / Have Got
nodes.summary: Talk about family, possessions and appearance with have and have got.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about family, things people own and what people look like, using have and have got.

objectives.text: Talk about possessions and family (I have two sisters)
Describe appearance (She has long hair)
Make negatives and questions (I don't have …, Have you got …?)

commonErrors.right: I don't have a car. / I haven't got a car.

commonErrors.wrong: Do you have got a pen?
commonErrors.right: Do you have a pen? / Have you got a pen?

id.title: Have / Have Got
id.summary: Membicarakan keluarga, barang milik dan ciri fisik dengan have dan have got.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan keluarga, barang yang dimiliki dan ciri fisik seseorang dengan have dan have got.

objectives.possession-family: Membicarakan barang milik dan keluarga (I have two sisters)
objectives.appearance: Mendeskripsikan ciri fisik (She has long hair)
objectives.negatives-questions: Membuat kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan (I don't have …, Have you got …?)

nodes.title: Adverbs of Frequency
nodes.summary: always, usually, sometimes, never — and asking How often …?
nodes.canDo: Can say how often they do things and ask others how often they do them.

objectives.text: Use always, usually, often, sometimes and never
Use adverbs of frequency in the right position
Ask how often questions

commonErrors.wrong: I go always to the gym.
commonErrors.right: I always go to the gym.

id.title: Kata Keterangan Frekuensi
id.summary: always, usually, sometimes, never — dan bertanya How often …?
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan seberapa sering kamu melakukan sesuatu dan menanyakannya ke orang lain.

objectives.frequency-words: Memakai always, usually, often, sometimes dan never
objectives.use-adverbs-of: Menempatkan kata keterangan frekuensi di posisi yang benar (sebelum kata kerja utama, setelah be)

nodes.title: Prepositions of Time & Place
nodes.summary: in, on, at for time, and in, on, under, next to, between and behind for place.
nodes.canDo: Can say when things happen and where things are, using basic prepositions of time and place.

objectives.text: Use in, on, at with times and dates
Use prepositions to describe location
Use everyday time expressions (in the morning, at night, at the weekend)

commonErrors.wrong: The bag is in under the table.
commonErrors.right: The bag is under the table.

id.title: Preposisi Waktu & Tempat
id.summary: in, on, at untuk waktu, serta in, on, under, next to, between dan behind untuk tempat.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan kapan sesuatu terjadi dan di mana benda berada dengan preposisi waktu dan tempat dasar.

objectives.use-in-on: Menggunakan in, on, at untuk waktu dan tanggal (at 7, on Monday, in May)
objectives.use-prepositions-to: Menggunakan preposisi untuk mendeskripsikan lokasi (in, on, under, next to, between, behind)
objectives.time-expressions: Memakai ekspresi waktu sehari-hari (in the morning, at night, at the weekend)

nodes.title: Asking Questions
nodes.summary: What, where, who, when, how — plus yes/no questions.
nodes.canDo: Can ask and answer simple questions about personal details, such as where someone lives and what they do.

objectives.text: Choose the right question word (what, where, who, when, why, how)
Put words in the right order in questions
Ask for and give basic personal information

id.title: Bertanya
id.summary: What, where, who, when, how — plus pertanyaan ya/tidak.
id.canDo: Bisa bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan sederhana tentang data pribadi, misalnya di mana seseorang tinggal dan apa pekerjaannya.

objectives.wh-words: Memilih kata tanya yang tepat (what, where, who, when, why, how)
objectives.question-order: Menyusun kata dengan urutan yang benar dalam pertanyaan
objectives.personal-info: Menanyakan dan memberikan informasi pribadi dasar

nodes.title: Countable, Uncountable, Some & Any
nodes.summary: Tell countable from uncountable nouns and use some, any, how much and how many.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about quantities of everyday things, using some, any, how much and how many.

objectives.text: Tell common countable and uncountable nouns apart (an apple vs rice)
Use some in positive sentences and any in negatives and questions
Ask How much …? and How many …?

commonErrors.wrong: How many water do you drink?
commonErrors.right: How much water do you drink?

id.title: Countable, Uncountable, Some & Any
id.summary: Membedakan kata benda yang bisa dan tidak bisa dihitung, serta memakai some, any, how much dan how many.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan jumlah benda sehari-hari dengan some, any, how much dan how many.

objectives.countable-uncountable: Membedakan kata benda countable dan uncountable yang umum (an apple vs rice)
objectives.some-any: Memakai some dalam kalimat positif dan any dalam kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan
objectives.how-much-many: Bertanya dengan How much …? dan How many …?

nodes.title: Present Continuous
nodes.summary: Talk about what is happening now.
nodes.canDo: Can say what people are doing right now and tell this apart from what they usually do.

objectives.text: Form present continuous sentences with am/is/are + -ing and spell -ing forms correctly (making, running)
Contrast now with routines

commonErrors.wrong: I am go to school every day.
commonErrors.right: I go to school every day.

id.title: Present Continuous
id.summary: Membicarakan apa yang sedang terjadi sekarang.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan apa yang sedang dilakukan seseorang saat ini dan membedakannya dari kebiasaan.

objectives.form-present-continuous: Membentuk kalimat present continuous dengan am/is/are + -ing dan menulis ejaan -ing dengan benar (making, running)
objectives.contrast-now-with: Membedakan kegiatan yang sedang terjadi dengan rutinitas

nodes.title: Can for Ability & Permission
nodes.summary: Say what you can and can't do, ask for help and ask for permission with can.
nodes.canDo: Can say what they can and can't do, make simple requests and ask for permission with can.

objectives.text: Talk about abilities with can / can't
Make polite requests with Can you …?
Ask for and give permission with Can I …?

id.title: Can untuk Kemampuan & Izin
id.summary: Katakan apa yang bisa dan tidak bisa kamu lakukan, minta bantuan dan minta izin dengan can.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan apa yang bisa dan tidak bisa dilakukan, mengajukan permintaan sederhana dan meminta izin dengan can.

objectives.ask-polite-requests: Mengajukan permintaan sopan dengan Can you …?
objectives.ask-permission: Meminta dan memberi izin dengan Can I …?

nodes.title: Imperatives & Let's
nodes.summary: Give and follow simple instructions and directions, and make suggestions with Let's.
nodes.canDo: Can give and understand simple instructions and directions, and suggest doing something together with Let's.

objectives.text: Give positive and negative instructions (Turn left. Don't run.)
Make suggestions with Let's …
Understand simple instructions and directions

id.title: Kalimat Perintah & Let's
id.summary: Memberi dan mengikuti instruksi serta arah sederhana, dan mengajak dengan Let's.
id.canDo: Bisa memberi dan memahami instruksi serta arah sederhana, dan mengajak melakukan sesuatu bersama dengan Let's.

objectives.imperatives: Memberi perintah positif dan negatif (Turn left. Don't run.)

nodes.title: Like + -ing & Would Like
nodes.summary: Talk about likes with like/love/hate + -ing, and ask for things politely with would like.
nodes.canDo: Can say what they like and don't like, and ask for things politely with I'd like.

objectives.text: Use like, love and hate + -ing or a noun
Ask for things politely with would like (I'd like a coffee)
Tell I like from I'd like

id.title: Like + -ing & Would Like
id.summary: Membicarakan kesukaan dengan like/love/hate + -ing, dan meminta sesuatu dengan sopan memakai would like.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan apa yang disukai dan tidak disukai, serta meminta sesuatu dengan sopan memakai I'd like.

objectives.like-ing: Memakai like, love dan hate + -ing atau kata benda
objectives.would-like: Meminta sesuatu dengan sopan memakai would like (I'd like a coffee)
objectives.like-vs-would-like: Membedakan I like dan I'd like

nodes.title: Past of To Be (was / were)
nodes.summary: Use was and were to talk about where people were and how things were in the past.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about where people were and how things were in the past.

objectives.text: Use was/were in positive sentences
Make negatives with wasn't/weren't
Ask and answer Was/Were …? questions

id.title: Bentuk Lampau To Be (was / were)
id.summary: Memakai was dan were untuk menceritakan keberadaan dan keadaan di masa lalu.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan di mana seseorang berada dan bagaimana keadaan di masa lalu.

nodes.title: And, But, Or, Because
nodes.summary: Join simple sentences with and, but and or, and give reasons with because.
nodes.canDo: Can link simple ideas with and, but, or and because.

objectives.text: Join sentences with and, but and or
Give reasons with because

commonErrors.wrong: I stay at home. Because I'm sick.
commonErrors.right: I stay at home because I'm sick.

commonErrors.wrong: I don't like tea and coffee.
commonErrors.right: I don't like tea or coffee.

id.title: And, But, Or, Because
id.summary: Menggabungkan kalimat sederhana dengan and, but dan or, serta memberi alasan dengan because.
id.canDo: Bisa menghubungkan ide sederhana dengan and, but, or dan because.

objectives.and-but-or: Menggabungkan kalimat dengan and, but dan or

nodes.title: Family & Home
nodes.summary: Words for family members, rooms and furniture, and how to describe your home.
nodes.canDo: Can name family members and describe their home in simple terms.

objectives.text: Name family members (parents, brother, aunt, cousin)
Name rooms and furniture (kitchen, bedroom, sofa, wardrobe)
Describe your home in a few sentences

commonErrors.wrong: I have three brothers: two boys and one girl.
commonErrors.right: I have three siblings: two brothers and one sister.

commonErrors.wrong: There is a bed in the kitchen room.
commonErrors.right: There is a bed in the bedroom.

id.title: Keluarga & Rumah
id.summary: Kosakata anggota keluarga, ruangan dan perabot, serta cara mendeskripsikan rumahmu.
id.canDo: Bisa menyebut anggota keluarga dan mendeskripsikan rumah dengan sederhana.

objectives.family: Menyebut anggota keluarga (parents, brother, aunt, cousin)
objectives.rooms-furniture: Menyebut ruangan dan perabot (kitchen, bedroom, sofa, wardrobe)

nodes.title: Food, Drinks & Shopping
nodes.summary: Words for food, drinks, containers and quantities, shops and prices.
nodes.canDo: Can name common food and drink, ask for quantities and talk about shops and prices.

objectives.text: Name common food and drinks
Use containers and quantities (a bottle of, a kilo of)
Name shops and talk about prices

id.title: Makanan, Minuman & Belanja
id.summary: Kosakata makanan, minuman, wadah dan takaran, toko serta harga.
id.canDo: Bisa menyebut makanan dan minuman umum, meminta jumlah tertentu, dan membicarakan toko serta harga.

objectives.containers-quantities: Memakai wadah dan takaran (a bottle of, a kilo of)
objectives.shops-prices: Menyebut jenis toko dan membicarakan harga

nodes.title: Town & Transport
nodes.summary: Words for places in town, ways to travel and simple directions.
nodes.canDo: Can name places in town, say how they travel and understand simple directions.

objectives.text: Name places in town (bank, station, post office)
Talk about transport (by bus, by train, on foot)
Use direction words (left, right, straight on)

commonErrors.wrong: I go to work with bus.
commonErrors.right: I go to work by bus.

commonErrors.wrong: Go straight and turn to left.
commonErrors.right: Go straight on and turn left.

id.title: Kota & Transportasi
id.summary: Kosakata tempat di kota, jenis transportasi dan arah sederhana.
id.canDo: Bisa menyebut tempat di kota, mengatakan cara bepergian dan memahami arah sederhana.

objectives.places-in-town: Menyebut tempat di kota (bank, station, post office)
objectives.transport: Membicarakan transportasi (by bus, by train, on foot)
objectives.direction-words: Memakai kata arah (left, right, straight on)

nodes.title: Jobs & Free Time
nodes.summary: Words for jobs and workplaces, hobbies and sports, and weekend activities.
nodes.canDo: Can say what people do for work and what they like doing in their free time.

objectives.text: Name jobs and workplaces
Talk about hobbies and sports (play football, go swimming)
Describe weekend activities

id.title: Pekerjaan & Waktu Luang
id.summary: Kosakata pekerjaan dan tempat kerja, hobi dan olahraga, serta kegiatan akhir pekan.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan pekerjaan seseorang dan apa yang suka dilakukan di waktu luang.

objectives.hobbies-sports: Membicarakan hobi dan olahraga (play football, go swimming)

nodes.title: Clothes, Weather & Body
nodes.summary: Words for clothes, the weather and parts of the body.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about clothes, describe the weather and name parts of the body.

objectives.text: Name clothes and say what people are wearing
Describe the weather (It's raining, It's hot)
Name parts of the body

commonErrors.wrong: She is using a red dress.
commonErrors.right: She is wearing a red dress.

id.title: Pakaian, Cuaca & Tubuh
id.summary: Kosakata pakaian, cuaca dan bagian tubuh.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan pakaian, mendeskripsikan cuaca dan menyebut bagian tubuh.

objectives.clothes: Menyebut pakaian dan mengatakan apa yang sedang dipakai seseorang

nodes.title: -s Endings, Contractions & Intonation
nodes.summary: Say -s endings correctly, use contractions and get the intonation of yes/no and wh- questions right.
nodes.canDo: Can pronounce -s endings and common contractions clearly and use the right intonation in simple questions.

objectives.text: Pronounce -s endings as /s/, /z/ or /ɪz/ (works, plays, watches)
Say common contractions (I'm, isn't, don't)
Use rising intonation for yes/no questions and falling intonation for wh- questions

commonErrors.right: watches with an extra syllable /ɪz/: WATCH-iz

commonErrors.wrong: Where do you live? said with rising intonation
commonErrors.right: Where do you live? with falling intonation at the end

id.title: Akhiran -s, Kontraksi & Intonasi
id.summary: Mengucapkan akhiran -s dengan benar, memakai kontraksi, dan intonasi yang tepat untuk pertanyaan yes/no dan wh-.
id.canDo: Bisa mengucapkan akhiran -s dan kontraksi umum dengan jelas serta memakai intonasi yang tepat dalam pertanyaan sederhana.

objectives.s-endings: Mengucapkan akhiran -s sebagai /s/, /z/ atau /ɪz/ (works, plays, watches)
objectives.question-intonation: Memakai intonasi naik untuk pertanyaan yes/no dan intonasi turun untuk pertanyaan wh-

nodes.title: Word Stress & Final Sounds
nodes.summary: Stress common words on the right syllable, pronounce final consonants, and check stress in a dictionary.
nodes.canDo: Can stress common words correctly and pronounce final consonants clearly enough to be understood.

objectives.text: Stress common words on the right syllable (TEAcher, hoTEL)
Pronounce final consonants and simple clusters (desk, lunch)
Check word stress in a dictionary

id.title: Tekanan Kata & Bunyi Akhir
id.summary: Memberi tekanan pada suku kata yang tepat, mengucapkan konsonan akhir, dan mengecek tekanan kata di kamus.
id.canDo: Bisa memberi tekanan yang tepat pada kata umum dan mengucapkan konsonan akhir cukup jelas agar mudah dipahami.

objectives.word-stress: Memberi tekanan pada suku kata yang tepat di kata umum (TEAcher, hoTEL)
objectives.final-consonants: Mengucapkan konsonan akhir dan gugus konsonan sederhana (desk, lunch)

nodes.title: Everyday Listening
nodes.summary: Catch personal details, numbers, prices, times and simple directions in slow, clear speech.
nodes.canDo: Can catch names, numbers, prices, times and simple directions when people speak slowly and clearly.

objectives.text: Catch personal details, numbers, prices and times
Understand simple directions
Get the key information from short, slow announcements

commonErrors.right: fifTEEN (stress at the end) vs FIFty (stress at the start)

id.title: Menyimak Sehari-hari
id.summary: Menangkap info pribadi, angka, harga, jam dan arah sederhana dari ucapan yang pelan dan jelas.
id.canDo: Bisa menangkap nama, angka, harga, jam dan arah sederhana jika orang berbicara pelan dan jelas.

objectives.catch-details: Menangkap info pribadi, angka, harga dan jam
objectives.short-announcements: Menangkap info kunci dari pengumuman pendek yang diucapkan pelan

nodes.title: Reading Short Texts
nodes.summary: Read menus, signs, simple timetables, short messages and profiles, and scan them for information.
nodes.canDo: Can understand menus, signs, simple timetables and short messages, and find specific information in them.

objectives.text: Understand menus, signs and simple timetables
Understand short messages and profiles
Scan a text for specific information

id.title: Membaca Teks Pendek
id.summary: Membaca menu, papan tanda, jadwal sederhana, pesan dan profil pendek, serta mencari info di dalamnya.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami menu, papan tanda, jadwal sederhana dan pesan pendek, serta menemukan info spesifik di dalamnya.

objectives.menus-signs-timetables: Memahami menu, papan tanda dan jadwal sederhana

nodes.title: Introducing Yourself
nodes.summary: Name, origin, job and interests in a few sentences.
nodes.canDo: Can introduce themselves, talk briefly about their interests and respond when others introduce themselves.

objectives.text: Introduce yourself with name, origin and job
Talk about your likes and interests
Respond when someone introduces themselves

commonErrors.right: I am from Indonesia. / I am Indonesian.

id.title: Memperkenalkan Diri
id.summary: Nama, asal, pekerjaan dan minat dalam beberapa kalimat.
id.canDo: Bisa memperkenalkan diri, sedikit menceritakan minat, dan menanggapi perkenalan orang lain.

objectives.introduce-yourself-with: Memperkenalkan diri dengan nama, asal dan pekerjaan
objectives.talk-about-your: Membicarakan hal yang disukai dan minat

nodes.title: Describing Your Day
nodes.summary: Describe your day in order with time expressions.
nodes.canDo: Can describe a typical day in order, using simple time expressions.

objectives.text: Describe a typical day in order (first, then, after that)
Use time expressions like at 7, in the morning, every day

commonErrors.wrong: Every day I wake up at 5 and I am pray.
commonErrors.right: Every day I wake up at 5 and pray.

id.title: Menceritakan Harimu
id.summary: Ceritakan harimu secara berurutan dengan keterangan waktu.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan hari biasa secara berurutan dengan keterangan waktu sederhana.

objectives.describe-a-typical: Menceritakan hari biasa secara berurutan (first, then, after that)
objectives.use-time-expressions: Menggunakan keterangan waktu seperti at 7, in the morning, every day

nodes.title: Writing About Yourself
nodes.summary: Write simple sentences about yourself, your family and your routine, and a short message or postcard.
nodes.canDo: Can write simple sentences about themselves and a short message or postcard of 25–35 words.

objectives.text: Write simple sentences about yourself, your family and your routine
Write a short message or postcard of 25–35 words
Use capital letters and punctuation correctly

id.title: Menulis tentang Diri Sendiri
id.summary: Menulis kalimat sederhana tentang diri, keluarga dan rutinitas, serta pesan atau kartu pos pendek.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis kalimat sederhana tentang diri sendiri serta pesan atau kartu pos pendek 25–35 kata.

objectives.sentences-about-me: Menulis kalimat sederhana tentang diri, keluarga dan rutinitas
objectives.short-message: Menulis pesan atau kartu pos pendek 25–35 kata
objectives.capitals-punctuation: Memakai huruf kapital dan tanda baca dengan benar

nodes.title: Everyday Conversation
nodes.summary: Short exchanges in shops, cafés and the street.
nodes.canDo: Can order food and drinks, ask for prices and directions, and keep a short, simple conversation going.

objectives.text: Order food and drinks (I'd like …)
Ask for prices and directions
